verdict.rationale: Relay lets admins issue cards with set spend limits, define roles, and separate funds into up to 20 checking accounts (useful as informal department/program buckets) with automated transfer rules, and 'multi-step approval rules' are mentioned on the pricing page. However there's no explicit 'budget' object with rolling caps per department/program beyond individual card limits, and community reviews note 'problems with prescribed limits,' suggesting enforcement isn't perfectly reliable. Missing for 10: a dedicated budget-creation feature (vs just card limits/accounts), documented department-level aggregate spend caps, and clear evidence enforcement is robust in practice.
